findings.why: The drawing in force (rev B) requires MAT-6082-T6 for BR-225. EN AW-7075 is a different alloy and is not the required grade. Its capability against SC-BR225-YS (Rp0.2 of at least 250 MPa) is not shown in any document.
EN AW-7075 is not in the material master, which lists only 6082 and 6061 here. It has no id, no temper and no yield data. A person must supply the material data.
No EN 10204 3.1 certificate for EN AW-7075 is in the documents. A person must say whether one exists.
